name: Manson Ignace
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Manson is a Clinical & Organizational Psychologist with over twenty-five year’s experience providing counselling, psychoeducation, critical incident response, psychological first aid and mental health interventions for individuals, couples, groups, teams and organisations in the public and private sectors including emergency service personnel. Since 2005, Lieutenant Commander Ignace has completed six operational deployments to the Middle East and the Ivory Coast with the RANR on ANZAC class frigates. Navy Psychologists provide mental health screening, psychological first aid and critical incident support to Australian Defence Force members.
specialties: EMDR, Trauma, Depression, Anxiety, Panic attacks, Complicated grief, Sexual or Physical abuse, Stress reduction, Disturbing memories, Phobias

name: Peta de Burgh
title: Social Worker
description: I am an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and EMDR Practitioner with over 18 years of experience in trauma, advocacy, and crisis intervention. My therapeutic work integrates EMDR, Somatic Trauma Therapy, and mindfulness-based practices, drawing on the latest research in polyvagal theory, neuroplasticity, and body psychotherapy to support lasting change and recovery.
specialties: EMDR, Addiction, Trauma, Depression, Stress reduction, Disturbing memories
